verdict: Google Business Profile has gone dark across all three locations this week.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, Google Business Profile was the only active channel this period — paid advertising is not yet running on any entity. Combined, your three locations generated 375 GBP actions over the last 28 days (calls, direction requests, and website clicks), but all three profiles have dropped to zero activity over the last 5–8 days, a confirmed visibility loss rather than normal fluctuation. The steep, simultaneous drop points to a listing suppression or eligibility issue, and we are investigating all three profiles now. In parallel, several planned workstreams — including contact list pulls needed to launch outreach and account data reconciliation needed to activate CRM sync — are being cleared so downstream activity can begin on schedule. The goal for the next period is to restore GBP visibility, confirm the root cause of the organic drop, and move the first outreach sequences into motion.
